title: CIRculating CANcer MAster-Protocol
official: MAster Protocol Studying the Impact of Blood Biopsy on Screening, Diagnosis, Diagnostic and Follow-up of Solid Cancer in Adult
summary: This exploratory study will focus on the development of the analyses of blood biomarkers to better understand the circulating biomarkers associated with cancer diagnosis, treatment efficacy and progressive disease

interventions.name: Blood sampling for biomarker analysis (microRNA, circulating DNA…)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult (\>18y)
* Owing a social security insurance
* Any solid cancer diagnosed by histopathology or cytology
* Patient with blood sampling required as per standard of care
* Informed consent signed

Exclusion Criteria:

* Refusal to participate
* No blood sampling required as per standard of care
* Hemoglobin \< 7g/dl (\< 9g/dl if respiratory or cardiovascular disease history)
* Heterologous blood transfusion in the last 48 hours
* Weight under 20 kg
